Exciting Casual Opportunity: Community Support Worker 

In the remote outback community of Ceduna, the work of a Community Support Worker carries real weight. At Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN), you'll be the person who helps someone stay in the home they love - offering practical support, genuine connection, and the kind of care that makes independence possible.

What You'll Be Doing

Working within EFNLHN's Consumer Directed Care model, you'll deliver support shaped by each client's own goals and preferences - because here, the consumer leads the care. Shifts, duties, and frequency are guided by the people you support, giving your work real purpose and variety.

Assist clients with personal hygiene, grooming, and mobility in a respectful and dignified manner

Perform household tasks including cleaning, laundry, meal preparation, and minor gardening

Provide reliable transport to appointments and community outings

Support social engagement and activities that contribute to each client's wellbeing

At the WHD4 level, deliver personal care to clients with more complex support needs

What You'll Bring

A warm, empathetic approach and the confidence to work independently within a remote community setting

Sound communication skills and genuine respect for people from diverse cultures and backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities central to the Ceduna region

Experience supporting aged, frail, or people living with disability

The ability to work collaboratively as part of a small, community-based team

For appointment at WHD4 level: Certificate III or higher in Individual Support (Aged Care, Disability, or Home and Community Care)

Life and Work in Ceduna with EFNLHN

EFNLHN serves one of South Australia's most geographically expansive regions, and the Ceduna Community and Allied Health team is a close-knit group united by a shared commitment to the people they serve. As part of SA Health, you'll have access to salary packaging benefits that meaningfully increase your take-home pay, ongoing training and development, and the professional backing of a respected public health network. Working casually means flexibility, while the Consumer Directed Care model ensures your days are varied and your contribution is visible. This is remote health care at its most human.

Apply Before 30 June 2027

Submit your application through the SA Health careers portal with a current resume and a cover letter outlining your experience in community or personal care. To learn more about the role, contact the EFNLHN Ceduna Community and Allied Health team directly. We strongly encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and those with lived experience in community care.

About Us

With its ancient outback landscapes, boutique vineyards, oyster farms and Australia's best-kept-secret surf coast, Eyre and Far North will inspire and energise you.

The Eyre and Far North Local Health Network (EFNLHN) is responsible for the planning and delivery of hospital and health services over 337,626 square kilometres, taking in the Eyre Peninsula, western part of South Australia and north to Coober Pedy. We are one of the largest LHNs by area in Australia and communities include Ceduna, Cleve, Coober Pedy, Cowell, Cummins, Elliston, Kimba, Oodnadatta, Port Lincoln, Streaky Bay, Tumby Bay and Wudinna.

Services include acute care, medical, accident and emergency, surgery, birthing and midwifery, specialist consultancy, renal dialysis, chemotherapy, transfusions, rehabilitation, residential and community aged care, respite care, transitional care packages, Aboriginal health, mental health, allied health, community health, community nursing, palliative care, community home support packages and home modifications.
